visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with an exterior wide shot of a restaurant storefront labeled "老二腿庫飯" under a large brown awning. A person on a scooter passes by on the street while another person in a purple jacket walks toward the entrance. The lighting is bright, natural daylight, suggesting a flat urban street setting. (2) The scene cuts to a macro close-up of a large metal pot filled with braised pork in a dark, glossy soy-based sauce. A metal ladle scoops up several large, tender-looking chunks of meat, showing the fat and skin glistening under the kitchen lights. (3) A staff member wearing bright purple hygienic gloves is shown from the chest down, holding a black bowl filled with white rice. They use a large metal spoon to carefully place a generous portion of braised pork and some liquid sauce over the rice. (4) A series of rapid close-up shots showcase various dishes: a bowl of braised pork rice garnished with yellowish pickled greens, a piece of meat held up by chopsticks to show its texture, and more sauce being drizzled over the rice. (5) The focus shifts to side dishes, including a plate of vibrant green blanched water spinach with a piece of fried tofu on the side, and a bowl of clear fish ball soup with three white, oblong-shaped fish balls being lifted by a black spoon. (6) A close-up of a bowl of minced pork rice follows, where a spoon mixes the finely chopped, fatty pork bits into the rice. The lighting highlights the rich oiliness of the topping against the white rice. (7) A unique dish of fried fish intestines is shown being picked up by chopsticks. The intestines look crispy and are served on a white paper-lined plate with a wedge of lemon. The camera angle is eye-level, focusing on the intricate texture. (8) The video shows more hot dishes: a fluffy-looking oyster omelet being pulled apart and a plate of stir-fried large intestines with shredded ginger. The colors are warm and inviting under bright indoor lighting. (9) The scene transitions to the restaurant interior, showing a row of male customers sitting at wooden tables against a bright green wall. Most are looking at their smartphones or eating. (10) The final shot returns to the exterior, displaying the full storefront and building facade. Information about the location in Fengshan is overlaid on the screen as the camera pans slightly to show the street environment.

His voice has a moderate pitch and clear articulation, characteristic of a professional lifestyle vlogger. An upbeat acoustic guitar melody with light percussion serves as the background music, creating a cheerful acoustic atmosphere. (2) As the narration transitions to describing the food, the speaker's tone becomes more enthusiastic, with a slight increase in pitch variability to emphasize points. The music maintains a steady tempo of around 120 BPM, with guitar strumming being the most prominent element. (3) Each transition between dishes is marked by the narrator's continuous flow of descriptive speech. There are no significant environmental noises, suggesting a high-quality studio recording. The background music volume is skillfully ducked beneath the voice. (4) During the description of the signature dishes, the narrator's vocal intensity remains conversational but focused. The acoustic texture is dominated by the mid-range frequencies of the voice and the bright notes of the guitar. No incidental noises are audible. (5) When discussing specialty items like fried fish intestines, the narrator's arousal level rises slightly, conveying genuine excitement. A subtle digital bubble sound effect is used to punctuate certain visual text overlays. (6) The video concludes with a polite sign-off and call to action. The narrator's voice maintains a positive valence throughout. The background music continues at a consistent volume until a smooth fade-out at the very end of the clip.
